node.title: The Coordination Entropy Trap in Large Scale Programs
node.reading:
The one-function-or-many analysis helps distinguish specialist consultation from a shared veto over every action. Trace the commitment, the evidence available to its holder and the route for escalation. Count waiting and reconstruction as well as meetings; a smaller reporting structure may still contain the same unresolved decision boundary.

Large programmes can become harder to coordinate than the transformation they are meant to deliver. Compressed accountability reduces layers, protects context and reconnects decisions with consequences.

When a programme involves mission-critical systems, legacy environments, multiple stakeholders, fragmented information, high operational risk and large-scale organisational complexity, the natural reaction is to add more structure.

The more layers are added to control the transformation, the more the transformation becomes a system that must itself be coordinated. The programme begins to consume its own energy maintaining alignment between its internal parts instead of changing the operation it was created to transform.

relations: The liberation strategy and compressed accountability both focus attention, but operate through different social and organizational mechanisms.
Una palanca social no es una partición algorítmica. Concentrar atención también puede ignorar dependencias o crear un cuello de botella de autoridad.
Coordination overhead can be examined through the time and disturbance required to answer a fixed operational question across handoffs.
No toda coordinación es desperdicio; mantener fija la calidad y el alcance de la respuesta que se compara.
Reducing decision handoffs helps only if the receiving owner retains enough context, authority and response capacity to resolve the operational case in time.
No toda capa es redundante ni eliminar una revisión independiente es equivalente a eliminar pérdida de traducción.
Before replacing a local database, reconstruct the corrections and capabilities it supports; a cleaner ownership map is not evidence that its contribution has been replaced.
No justifica conservar todo shadow IT ni desconocer riesgos reales de la base local.
Decision-level dispersion and downstream coupling make the coordination-entropy discussion more precise by separating agreement burden from the propagation of a blocked decision.
Son unidades distintas: número de personas, puertas de acuerdo y dependencias de proceso no se sustituyen entre sí.
The coordination-entropy account can motivate a factorial test of information and joint-transition mechanisms, including cases where clarity alone does not activate capability.
Es una pregunta de investigación posterior, no una explicación causal ya demostrada de los programas históricos.
For a complementary reading, see [The coordination-entropy trap in large programmes](https://jubap.net/the-coordination-entropy-trap-in-large-scale-programs/).
